prompts.well-v1.png: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one isolated image-to-3D reference for a premium children's 3D toy farm. A beautiful compact rustic stone well, tactile rounded sculpted toy style matching warm painted wood farm buildings. Large round stone well ring made from two courses of chunky warm ivory and pale gray rounded stones, subtle seams and bevels; thick smooth stone coping around a genuinely OPEN dark empty circular shaft, no lid, no solid disk, no water surface. Two stout honey-colored wooden upright posts stand at the left and right sides of the well, near the back half. A SMALL barn-red tiled gable canopy is mounted behind the posts over only the BACK third of the well: its front eave ends behind the center of the shaft so the front two-thirds of the well mouth remain plainly visible from above. Roof ridge left-to-right, a few broad rounded coral red clay tiles, cream wood end trim, charming but restrained craft detail. Keep a clear rectangular window between the upright posts for adding an animated axle later. There is NO axle, NO horizontal windlass, NO crank, NO handle, NO bucket, NO rope, NO water, NO plants, NO hanging ornament, NO animals. One coherent structural well housing, no loose parts, no ground plinth. Low stout stone ring about one-third of total structure height, wooden posts and canopy make the total height about equal to overall width. Three-quarter front-right view from a little above, visibly show the empty shaft and the canopy offset to the BACK so an animated bucket at the front can be seen by a high game camera. Bright neutral soft studio lighting, warm cream/honey/coral materials, subtle hand-painted wood grain, minimal contact shadow. Entire object framed with margin, pure white background. Polished professional friendly mobile game asset, not photorealistic, not a sketch, not flat illustration. No letters, no words, no labels, no watermark, no collage.
